items.title: Red faces as Sydney Marathon medal shows German stadium
items.description: A medal minted for finishers in the Sydney Marathon features a skyline of the city — with one landmark from rather far away. Organizers say the muddle only makes the medal "a little more unique."

Get those jack-o’-lanterns out, because Halloween is just around the corner!</p><p>Just kidding, no, it’s not.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/aug/23/halloween-capitalism-climate-change">Continue reading...</a>
